# Reliability, observability and operations · project standards (detail)

<!-- docs/standards/operations.md · Generated by project-init v0.4.1 on 2026-11-17.
On-demand reference: not loaded automatically. The short rules Claude follows are in .claude/rules/operations.md. -->

## Logging
- **Rule:** Log with the standard `logging` module to stdout, where Streamlit Community Cloud collects it. No `print()` in app code and no log files. Never log keys, scenario text, feedback or model output.
- **Why:** stdout logging works the same locally and on the platform, and the log is the easiest place for visitor text to leak.
- **Status:** Adopting.

## Metrics and health endpoints
- **Rule:** Not applied. The platform exposes no custom endpoints or metrics.
- **Why:** Metrics and health checks matter when you run the infrastructure yourself.
- **Decision:** Kept the current hosting (SPEC section 6).
- **Status:** Kept current (doesn't fit the platform).

## Graceful shutdown and degradation
- **Rule:** The platform handles shutdown. The app degrades instead of failing: if stage 2 fails, the diagnosis from stage 1 is kept.
- **Why:** A partial answer is better than an error screen.
- **Decision:** Kept the current spec. There is no shutdown hook to manage on this platform.
- **Status:** Kept current (ROADMAP M6).
